scenes.title: What is a differential pair?
scenes.narration: A differential amplifier uses two nodes with equal, opposite signal swings. It’s the industry choice for high-performance circuits because it rejects common-mode supply noise.

scenes.title: Common-mode response
scenes.narration: In a symmetric circuit, common-mode inputs shift the bias points. We analyze this by assuming nodes are shorted, treating the pair as one composite device.

scenes.title: Common-mode gain formula
scenes.narration: The common-mode gain depends on the load resistance and the current source impedance. It shows how much input variation leaks through to the output.
